visual_match.prompt: Examine the image. Which option exactly matches the target? Reply with only its single letter. Do not use tools.

classification.prompt: Classify each item as urgent if its severity is high OR its deadline is at most 2 days away; otherwise routine. Items: A severity low deadline 3 days; B severity high deadline 8 days; C severity low deadline 2 days; D severity medium deadline 4 days. Return only a JSON object mapping each letter to urgent or routine. Do not use tools.

natural_writing.prompt: Write a concise, natural customer notice of 40 to 70 words using only these facts: a migration is scheduled for 12 November 2026 at 09:00 UTC; the service will be read-only for 15 minutes; a backup has been created; Maya is the contact for questions. Do not promise zero disruption or invent other details. Return only the notice. Do not use tools.

wall_boundary: before process launch through process exit
scope: small direct-call diagnostic; upstream model and billing unverified
